items.title: Australian stuns The Open with equal lowest round in major golf history
items.description: Australia's Lucas Herbert takes a shock lead at The Open after posting a stunning round where he birdied six of his opening nine holes.

items.title: Hanson dodges questions about who paid for Italy trip
items.description: One Nation leader Pauline Hanson refuses to say who paid for her recent trip to Italy, where she attended a fashion show and was spotted at a five-star resort.

items.title: 'Bring back public flogging': Inquiry hears of vicious online trolling
items.description: Racial slurs, online trolls and fears of far-right violence have taken a toll on First Nations people, a federal inquiry heard this week.

items.title: There's something odd about most couples. Geneticists and sociologists have noticed it too
items.description: Once I saw it, I couldn't unsee it. Had I noticed something real or was it just the people around me? I set out to find out what the data had to say.

items.title: Sam Neill's advice for when the world seems too dark
items.description: The world has been remembering Sam Neill's incredible film and television career in the wake of the actor's death, but his off-screen antics left a robust impact.

items.title: Malcolm Roberts falsely claimed COVID-19 vaccines caused miscarriages
items.description: The One Nation senator made the previously unreported remarks during a live stream discussion with three prominent Australian anti-vaccine mandate activists.

items.title: Refinery shortages create new fuel crisis
items.description: There is a rapidly escalating supply crunch that has yet to show up on oil markets. While the price of crude has risen in the past week as the fragile Iran war ceasefire has crumbled, the remarkably restrained price moves have helped create a false sense of security.

items.title: The race to find routes around the Strait of Hormuz and which nation is winning

items.title: Subsidy changes prompt battery installation collapse

items.title: Lao authorities charge distillery owners over fatal methanol poisoning
items.description: Bianca Jones and Holly Morton-Bowles, both 19, died after the incident at the Nana Backpackers Hostel in Vang Vieng in November 2024.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
